card.title: Obey Without Explanation
card.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 empty-box order lacks a practical aim, A3 names obedience as purpose and A5 adds reversal without questioning after compliance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 purpose question causes A3 authority test; B4 completion causes A5 a redundant return and silence condition.

relationship.evidence: B2 reasonably asks why and B4 performs the requested action.

heightening.evidence: B4 successful compliance becomes A5 another more pointless and constrained test.

specificity.evidence: A1 desk and empty box establish a small workplace command with deliberately absent utility.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 without the question uses B2 earlier inquiry to sharpen the final obedience condition.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 asks the purpose of A1 task.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 responds to B4 compliance with reversing the work and forbidding the earlier question.
